items.t: AeroVironment, Inc. to Announce Second Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 Earnings and Host Conference Call
items.sum: ARLINGTON, Va., November 24, 2026--AeroVironment, Inc. ("AV") (NASDAQ: AVAV) will report its financial results for the second quarter fiscal year 2027, which ended October 31, 2026, after the market closes on Tuesday, December 8, 2026. Management will host a conference call and live audio webcast at 4:30 p.m. Eastern time that same day to discuss the results.
